title: Global smooth approximation of a Lipschitz function by mollification (uniform, same Lipschitz constant)
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, every L ≥ 0 and every L-Lipschitz function h : ℝ^P → ℝ there is a sequence (g_k)_{k∈ℕ} of functions ℝ^P → ℝ such that every g_k is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ ∞), every g_k is L-Lipschitz on ℝ^P, and g_k → h uniformly on ℝ^P as k → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (h : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L h → ∃ g : ℕ → Eucl P → ℝ, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (g k)) ∧ (∀ k, LipschitzWith L (g k)) ∧ TendstoUniformly g h atTop
